en: A black‑and‑white photograph of an early 20th‑century steamship at sea, viewed in full side profile. The ship has a single funnel with a large letter "S" painted on it, two masts with rigging, and smoke trailing from the funnel. A small flag flies from a pole at the stern. The sea is slightly choppy and the horizon is faint in the background. There is no visible border, caption, or decorative framing typical of modern postcards.
